findings.current: “It’s good to see you alive, Officer Jang.”
findings.defect: The line makes Jang Il the person who survived, though the speaker is the one returning alive.
findings.rationale: The merchant master has survived the attack and is greeting Jang Il.
findings.replacement: “Glad I survived to see you again, Officer Jang.”
findings.source: 이렇게 살아서 다시 보니 반갑군. 장 무관.

findings.current: Jang Il followed the trading company master’s gaze and felt the world go dark.
findings.defect: The merchant master points toward the bodies; the draft changes that action to a look.
findings.rationale: 손끝 identifies the direction indicated by his fingertip, not his gaze.
findings.replacement: Jang Il looked where the trading company master pointed and felt the world go dark.
findings.source: 상단주의 손끝을 따라 고개를 돌린 장일은

findings.current: “Even when their legs were cut off, even when their arms were gone, they kept coming.
findings.defect: The draft severs the attackers’ legs, while the source says their legs were cut and distinguishes that from arms being torn off.
findings.rationale: 다리가 베이고 describes cut legs; 팔이 날아가도 supplies the severed-limb image.
findings.replacement: “Even with their legs slashed and their arms torn off, they kept coming.

findings.current: “The battle was over in less than half a shichen, and our side broke.
findings.defect: “Less than” changes the stated duration, and the draft drops that the battle ended one-sidedly.
findings.rationale: 불과 반 시진 만에 specifies just half a shichen; 일방적으로 describes the one-sided outcome.
findings.replacement: “The battle ended decisively in just half a shichen—roughly an hour—and our side broke.
findings.source: 전투는 불과 반 시진 만에 일방적으로 끝났고

findings.current: The death of one of their men set off a fierce battle.
findings.defect: The draft assigns the first death to the caravan, but the source leaves whose death it was unspecified.
findings.rationale: 누군가의 죽음 does not identify the dead person’s side.
findings.replacement: Someone’s death set off a fierce battle.
findings.source: 누군가의 죽음을 신호탄으로 치열한 전투가 벌어졌다.

findings.current: The trading companies’ guards and the hired wandering martial artists fought back.
findings.defect: “Guards” omits that the companies had raised or trained these fighters themselves, a contrast with the hired martial artists.
findings.rationale: 상단에서 키워 낸 distinguishes the companies’ own trained fighters from 고용된 낭인들.
findings.replacement: The fighters trained by the trading companies and the hired wandering martial artists fought back.
findings.source: 상단에서 키워 낸 무사들과 고용된 낭인들

summary: Several scene facts and physical details are altered, chiefly who survived, how the merchant indicated the bodies, the attackers’ injuries, and the battle’s duration.
